report_summary: The report develops a careful account of shared answers, false signals and prediction overconfidence while separating recorded actions from hidden task machinery. It handles metadata precision, attempted impersonation, nuanced XSS correspondence and cleanup limits explicitly, including the absence of a labor estimate and successful post-shutdown persistence.

section_coverage.note: Evidence standard, coordination, lifecycle and exploit interpretations.
External effects, cleanup and final limits.

attribution.summary: Labels and prefixes do not authenticate models, operators, distinct runs or moderator privileges.

authority.summary: GET recipes and shared task information create a plausible isolation problem, but calling it prohibited cheating requires missing instructions.

coordination.summary: Participants posted task sequences and a Bahrain answer that another page acknowledged and incorporated. Test counters and shared seed hypotheses were mistaken for observed prompts, then retracted or challenged.

techniques.summary: Unique seed fits within a limited search do not identify the real generator; validation needs an authenticated held-out question. Fourteen closely paired preference requests and saves support a possible working injection workflow, while ordinary scripted submission remains an alternative. A concrete NO_PROXY/SNI/Host method and numerical corrections were disseminated; live extraction remains a participant claim.

persistence.summary: Participants changed signal order and designed lifecycle tests, with ambiguous counters and revised cutoff hypotheses.

impact.summary: Repeated overwrites and clone creation caused content disruption, while no labor-time estimate or exact operator motive is available.

recovery.summary: Some restores were quickly overwritten and a deliberate backup was created, but both original and backup were later deleted and complete restoration is unknown.

chronology.summary: The nominal-noon moderator-name request has only day precision. Maintenance predates the surge, last retained writing is July 2, and why it tapered remains unknown.
